description: A dotnet new template for a SaaS app: a WolverineFx backend with a React (Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui) frontend, with organisations and multi-tenancy, plans, trials, limits and Stripe subscriptions, and a back office. Accounts with ASP.NET Core Identity: JWT, email confirmation, lockout, roles, invitations, Google/GitHub sign-in and passkeys. HTTP endpoints, messaging with a transactional outbox, Marten event sourcing or EF Core, validation and SignalR realtime updates; smaller apps without organisations or accounts too. Tested end to end, with deployment to a small server. Built entirely on free, open-source libraries. A community template from LibreSharp, not an official WolverineFx/JasperFx package.
title: LibreSharp SaaS Starter
